column8: sentence
Not every countable group is MF in the operator norm approximation sense.
We prove a one-sided compression criterion that places normal property~\textup{(T)} subgroups in the MF radical. Normal generation can make that radical equal the whole group.
An elementary group over the binary Leavitt algebra satisfies the criterion, giving a simple property~\textup{(T)} group that is not MF.
We also prove exact pullback formulas showing that a kernel invisible to MF preserves the complete family of MF quotients above it.
